description: Source code for CUDA generator implementation in PyTorch, managing CUDA RNG states, generator creation, and graph registration.

classes.name: CUDAGeneratorState
classes.description: Manages internal state of CUDA RNG, including seed, offset, and graph registration.

classes.name: CUDAGeneratorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CUDA RNG generator, handling seed, offset, state serialization, and graph interactions.

methods.name: getDefaultCUDAGenerator
methods.description: Returns the default CUDA generator for a specified device.

methods.name: createCUDAGenerator
methods.description: Creates a new CUDA generator for a specified device.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the current generator state.

methods.name: increase
methods.description: Increases internal offset based on a given increment.

methods.name: register_graph
methods.description: Registers the generator state with a CUDA graph.

methods.name: unregister_graph
methods.description: Unregisters the generator state from a CUDA graph.

methods.name: capture_prologue
methods.description: Prepares the generator state for CUDA graph capture.

methods.name: capture_epilogue
methods.description: Finalizes the capture phase, returning total offset increment.

methods.name: replay_prologue
methods.description: Prepares generator state for replay with total increment.

methods.name: set_current_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the generator.

methods.name: set_offset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the generator.

methods.name: get_offset
methods.description: Returns the current offset.

methods.name: current_seed
methods.description: Returns the current seed.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Generates a nondeterministic seed and sets it.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the internal state as a CPU tensor.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the internal state from a CPU tensor.

methods.name: graphsafe_set_state
methods.description: Sets generator state safely for graph use.

methods.name: graphsafe_get_state
methods.description: Gets generator state safely for graph use.

methods.name: set_philox_offset_per_thread
methods.description: Sets the per-thread offset, enforcing multiple of 4.

methods.name: philox_offset_per_thread
methods.description: Returns the current per-thread offset.

methods.name: philox_cuda_state
methods.description: Returns a PhiloxCudaState for RNG, with incremented offset.

methods.name: philox_engine_inputs
methods.description: Returns seed and offset pair for call sites.

methods.name: device_type
methods.description: Returns device type (CUDA).

methods.name: clone_impl
methods.description: Clones the generator implementation.
